name: Miti Restaurant & Cafe
address: Al Balorah - Shop no - 11th St - near Park Regis - Al Karama - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: We bring to you the aromatic flavours & culinary delights of authentic India in the heart of Dubai.

reviews.author: Farha Azhar
reviews.text:
Tried Mitti Restaurant and cafe new menu and it was an incredible experience✨ Every dish is full of flavor and beautifully presented. Started with the fresh Avocado Bhel and Broccoli Bhanola, then moved on to the smoky Chicken Tikka Smoked Pot and creamy Methi Malai Seekh 🍗🌿. The Almond & Spinach Ricotta Pizza was cheesy, nutty and absolutely delicious 🍕. Finished the night with the indulgent Malai Kulfi 🍨.
The ambience is perfect with live music, premium sheesha and amazing vibes truly a top spot for a Dubai night out. Highly recommend trying the new menu  every dish is a delight and worth it

reviews.author: Bells Noble
reviews.text:
It’s a nice place to chill for a while. Separate areas for smokers and non-smokers.
Live performances are cool, but the artists aren’t interactive with everyone equally; they seem to stick to a bunch of friends only. You’d be disappointed if you’re used to going to Firangi, for example.
The service is pretty ok, with no special dedication.
The food and drinks are pretty ok as well. Opt for the costly dishes to get a nice presentation for your insta.
I wouldn’t recommend staying back for longer than an hour, unless if you’ve got the large couches on the right. The chairs and tables are too small.

reviews.author: Ajeet Kumar
reviews.text: Had an amazing weekend experience here! The food was absolutely delicious, and the ambience was beautiful and relaxing. The highlight of the evening was definitely the live singing — it made the whole experience even more enjoyable and memorable.

reviews.author: Travel , Food lover & reviewer
reviews.text:
Miti is a restaurant with shisha lounge style seating at the back with jungle ambience, on the main road in Karama towards Burjuman . After entering you take the stairs to 1st floor where the indoor seating area has a nice Bar style counter. When I went on a Friday evening, this place was taken up by large groups and I was directed to the backside where, probably an open area was converted into a shisha and lounge style place with sofas and comfortable seating arrangements, and also many large TV screens showing live IPL matches. On the right side the floor is slightly raised- so be careful in the low light ambience. The lumination of the lights can be altered as per requirement. They are covered with greeneries to give a relaxed vibe. I found the crowd starting to gather after 9:30 pm & reserved sighs cropping up on the tables. I specially liked the stylish lighted water in the glass containers of the shisha throbbing with the strong beats of the music played in the restaurant. Sometimes the music and tv , both played in tandem creating a very strong confusing sound mismatch for me. I understand that there is a live entertainment event at some times - but I forgot to ask the timings.
I was alone and the service was okayish. At the end one staff did ask me if the food was alright with a smile.
I ordered -
•Garlic butter prawns- 63 aed- 5/5. Lovely with neither a string smell of garlic nor too spicy. Nice buttery soft & large prawns. Awesome modern cutleries.
•Bhindi masala - 43 aed. Excellent. Good for one person. Again not very spicy. 4.5/5.
•Butter naan- 10 aed.
•Tawa roti- 7 aed.
•Mixed sweet and salty lime soda. 15 aed. Nicely presented.

My food experience was overall excellent.
They have many items which could be explored in future. Some are good accompaniments for the Shisha. Some are quite unique in presentation and concept.

Recommended for a rendezvous with friends ideally and not alone. And if you want to focus only on food then preferably seat in the inner seating area.

reviews.author: Shikha Anand
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time at Miti Restaurant & Cafe in Dubai. The food was delicious, the ambience was vibrant and beautifully designed, and the overall vibe made the evening feel special. The live music added great energy to the atmosphere, making it a perfect place to relax and enjoy with friends or family. The service was attentive, and the entire experience felt warm and welcoming. Definitely a place I’d love to visit again and highly recommend for anyone looking for good food, great music, and memorable vibes in Dubai.

reviews.author: Hayat Khan
reviews.text: Ordered from Miti for a birthday party and they nailed it! 🎉 Food was delicious, on time, and a total hit with the guests. Big thanks to Ritvik and Shahriyar for making everything so smooth and easy. Best in Dubai, all my orders are going to Miti from now on! 🙌

reviews.author: Prakash Mishra
reviews.text:
We visited the restaurant twice during our weekend staycation. On the positive side, the food was excellent on both occasions, the shishas were great, and the staff was genuinely warm and attentive. Service was smooth despite the crowd, which we really appreciated.
However, the experience during the live music nights wasn’t as enjoyable. The space felt extremely cramped, with tables placed too close together, leaving barely any room to move once seated. With many guests smoking, it also became quite uncomfortable as the smoke lingered heavily in the air. It seems the restaurant has added more tables than the space can comfortably accommodate.
Overall, it’s a great spot for food and shisha, but on weekends it’s best to reserve a table in advance to avoid long wait times and to be prepared for a packed atmosphere during live music events.

reviews.author: Dubaivibes4u
reviews.text:
⭐ Extremely Disappointing Experience – Poor Service and Unprofessional Staff Behaviour

I used to visit Miti Cafe & Restaurant regularly, but after today’s experience, I am genuinely disappointed and reconsidering whether I would return.

I ordered only one portion of French fries. After finishing, I asked the staff member Devender to clear the table. He took away the leftovers and then came back with another plate of French fries and a bill showing two portions.

I immediately told him that I had ordered only one portion and that I did not want the additional fries. Instead of simply checking the order or correcting the mistake, he started arguing with me in front of my guest and insisted that I had ordered the second portion and that I had to take it.

I clearly explained several times that I had neither ordered nor wanted the extra fries, but he continued arguing. I eventually had to call the manager, after which the additional portion was removed from the bill.

The billing issue was corrected, but the way the staff member handled the situation was completely unacceptable. Customers should not be made to feel uncomfortable, embarrassed, or pressured in front of their guests because of a mistake in an order.

Mistakes happen in every restaurant. What matters is how the staff handles them. In this case, there was no professional communication or basic courtesy.

As a regular customer, this was particularly disappointing. I expected much better service and respect from a place I had visited so many times. I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and ensures that customers are treated with courtesy and professionalism in the future.

reviews.author: Deepa Nair
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at MITI Restaurant, and the experience was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment we arrived, the ambiance was warm and inviting, striking a perfect balance between modern elegance and comfort.
The menu offered a diverse selection of dishes, each thoughtfully crafted and full of flavor. Every item we tried—from appetizers to dessert—was prepared with evident care and culinary expertise. The ingredients were fresh, and the presentation was impeccable.
What truly set the experience apart, however, was the professionalism and attention to detail demonstrated by the restaurant’s manager, Mr. Suraj Babu. His leadership was evident in every aspect of the operation. He maintained a calm, composed presence while ensuring that every guest received personalized attention. His deep knowledge of the menu, ability to handle special requests, and genuine hospitality made our visit memorable.
Suraj Babu embodies what it means to be a true hospitality professional—courteous, attentive, and always striving for excellence. It’s clear that he leads by example, and his team reflects his high standards of service.
I highly recommend MITI Restaurant to anyone seeking a top-tier dining experience. And if you're fortunate enough to meet Mr. Suraj Babu during your visit, you’ll quickly understand why this place is so highly regarded.
reviews.owner_reply:
We are thrilled to hear about your exceptional experience at MITI Restaurant, Deepa! Thank you for complimenting our ambiance, diverse menu, and the care that goes into each dish. It’s wonderful to know that Mr. Suraj Babu’s leadership had such a positive impact on your visit. We strive to provide top-tier service, and your recommendation means a lot to us. We look forward to welcoming you back soon for another memorable dining experience!

Mgmt Miti Resturant & Cafe

reviews.text: The food was good, and the service was great. reviews.author: Mary Cynthia
reviews.text:
Visited Miti recently, and while the ambiance was nice, the food was quite disappointing. We tried their pani puri and it turned out to be the worst we've had. The Bombay-style chicken chowmein tasted like regular noodles drenched in ketchup, which was a letdown. Their lacha papad was average at best.

The biggest disappointment was the biryani—we specifically asked for it to be spicy, but instead of a well-balanced heat, they simply chopped excessive green chilies and scattered them on top. The chicken Hakka noodles had a smoky flavor, which the kids didn’t enjoy.

However, not everything was bad. The crispy spinach chicken was enjoyable, and the chicken tikka masala, along with the garlic naan, was quite good.

Overall, Miti didn’t live up to expectations. It’s a one-time try for us, and we wouldn’t go back.
reviews.owner_reply:
We appreciate your feedback, Mary. We're glad to hear you enjoyed the crispy spinach chicken and chicken tikka masala, but we apologize for the disappointing experience with the other dishes. Your comments on the food quality and flavors will be reviewed with our team to make necessary improvements. Thank you for sharing your thoughts with us, and we hope to do better in the future.

Mgmt Miti Resturant & Cafe
Best Restaurant and Cafe in Karama

reviews.author: SOMIT LADDHA
reviews.text:
Miti Restaurants: A Culinary Oasis in Karama (5/5 Stars)

Miti Restaurants shines brightly in Karama, offering a delightful experience for vegetarians and non-vegetarians alike. Their menu boasts a vibrant tapestry of flavors, from the lively spirit of Mumbai street food to the comforting embrace of traditional dishes like sarso ka saag with makki ki roti.

Here's why Miti truly impressed me:

A Feast for the Senses: The diverse menu caters to every taste bud. My personal favorites were the Jini dosa and Pani Puri – the flavors were absolutely phenomenal!

Mocktail Marvels: Ditch the ordinary drinks! Miti boasts an imaginative selection of mocktails, including the creamy candy floss and the playful bubble blaster, perfect for a refreshing and unique experience.

Hospitality at its Finest: The staff's warmth and attentiveness are truly commendable. They provided excellent recommendations and ensured a thoroughly enjoyable dining experience. A special shoutout to Manager Mr. Suraj for his exceptional service!

Charming Ambiance: The restaurant exudes a beautiful and inviting atmosphere, ideal for a relaxed lunch, a fun gathering with friends, or even a special occasion.

Shisha Paradise: Shisha enthusiasts will delight in Miti's extensive selection of flavors, catering to every preference.
Weekend Entertainment: Live bands and music on weekends add a vibrant energy to the atmosphere.

Convenience Assured: Finding parking is a breeze! Spaces are readily available just outside or behind the restaurant.

Miti Restaurants is a fantastic choice for a complete and memorable dining experience. From the professional staff to the delectable food, the creative mocktails, and the lively ambiance, Miti earns a resounding 5/5 star recommendation!
